facts: Parties: Ingleby Marine Ltd (Company) and Dunmore Retail Group Securities (Underwriter).
Clause 3: the Company shall pay the Underwriters a commission of 5.5% of the gross proceeds of the Offering (12,500,000 shares at $14.00 per share), being $11,068,750.
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 3,200,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 16,000,000 Firm Shares.
Issuer: Ingleby Marine Ltd. The date of this Prospectus is 12 August 2026.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $150,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $68,000,000; capital expenditure $45,000,000; general corporate purposes $42,000,000.
